info.title: Multiroom Audio Hub v2 API
info.description: Professional REST API v2 for real-time multi-room audio routing. Provides full CRUD for inputs, output volume/mute control, route lifecycle management, instant URI-based playback, and idempotent master mute control.

tags.name: Chimes
tags.description: Short sounds that can play before a route's audio

tags.name: TTS Voices
tags.description: The voices a configured provider offers

tags.name: TTS
tags.description: Text-to-speech announcements to an output or a group

tags.name: Extensions
tags.description: Inventory of discovered extensions — what loaded, what didn't, and why

tags.name: Playback
tags.description: Instant URI-based audio playback — create ephemeral input and route in one call

tags.name: Outputs
tags.description: Audio output management — list outputs, control volume and mute state

tags.name: Groups
tags.description: Audio output group management — list groups and control group volume

tags.name: TTS Cache
tags.description: The on-disk cache of synthesized audio

tags.name: Info
tags.description: Which hub is running, its versions, and when it started

tags.name: Inputs
tags.description: Audio input lifecycle management — create, list, retrieve, and delete ephemeral inputs

tags.name: Master Mute
tags.description: System-wide master mute control. Master mute is a layer above each output's own mute: while it is on every output is silent, and turning it off restores each output's own mute. It does not change any output's `muted`.

tags.name: Routes
tags.description: Audio route lifecycle — create, list, retrieve, stop, and transfer routes

put.description: Sets the volume of this route only, also on a route started without one. The route ramps to it on every output it plays on, replacing those outputs' volumes for this route; no other route and no output's volume changes, so the room's volume control does not reach it. Accepted while the route is starting or paused. A route volume cannot be removed once set.

200.description: Route volume set; the body is the route

400.description: Validation error: volume missing or outside 0-100

put.summary: Set pause state on a route
put.description: Pauses or resumes audio playback for an active route. Set paused=true to pause, paused=false to resume. Idempotent — setting the same state returns 200 OK with the current state.

400.description: Route not active, input does not support pause, or validation error

put.description: Sets the volume level for an audio output. Returns the applied volume in the response.
Mutes or unmutes an audio output. Returns the applied mute state.

Enables or disables an audio output. A disabled output remains registered but is unavailable for new route creation. Disabling also takes it out of playback: a route addressed to it stops, and a group route keeps playing on its other members. Enabling puts it back into every live group route (playing, paused or starting) whose enabled group contains it, under the same route ID, and never stops a route; a route stopped by the disable does not come back.

get.description: Returns the current global mute state. When active, all audio outputs are silenced whatever their own mute.

put.description: Sets the global mute state. Master mute is a layer above each output's own mute: while it is on every output is silent, and turning it off restores each output's own mute. It does not change any output's `muted`. PUT is idempotent — same request repeated produces the same result.

Promotes a runtime input to a kept (STORED) one: it no longer auto-removes and survives a restart. Its id, name, enabled state and every setting stay as they are, and a route playing it is not touched. Already kept: 200 with no change. A configured input is already kept in `multiroom.yml` (400).

200.description: Input kept, or it already was

400.description: A configured input cannot be promoted, or no handler or resolver plays the input's link

404.description: Input not found (it may have been removed when its route ended)

500.description: The store is read-only, timed out or failed. The input is unchanged; `detail` names the cause

put.description: Enables or disables an audio input. A disabled input remains registered but is unavailable for new route creation. Disabling also takes it out of playback: every route playing it stops, including routes sharing a hardware input and paused routes, and an input registered with auto-remove is then removed. Enabling starts nothing.

500.description: A kept (STORED) input could not be saved: the store is read-only, timed out or failed. The input is unchanged; `detail` names the cause

put.description: Changes the display name of a configured or runtime input. The name is trimmed and may be at most 64 characters; null, empty or blank restores the original name (the configured one, or the one the input was registered with). A rename lasts as long as the input's definition: until a restart for a configuration input, until it is removed for a runtime input. Playback is not interrupted.

200.description: Input renamed, or nothing to change

400.description: Name too long or contains a control character, a blank name for a kept (STORED) input, or unreadable body

500.description: A kept (STORED) input could not be saved: the store is read-only, timed out or failed. The name is unchanged; `detail` names the cause

put.summary: Set volume for all outputs in a group
put.description: Sets the volume level for every output in the specified group.

put.summary: Mute or unmute all outputs in a group
put.description: Sets the mute state for every output in the specified group. Idempotent — setting the same state returns 200 OK with the current state.

Enables or disables an output group. A disabled group remains registered but is unavailable for new route creation. Disabling also stops every route addressed to the group; routes addressed directly to a member output keep playing. Enabling starts nothing.

get.description: Returns all current routes with their input, target, and status. Supports optional query parameters for filtering by status, inputId, and targetId (AND logic).

parameters.name: targetId
parameters.description: Filter by target output or group ID

post.description: Routes audio from an input to a target output or group. Resolves the target based on targetType (SINGLE_OUTPUT or OUTPUT_GROUP).

404.description: Input, output, or group not found

409.description: Route not admitted: the input, output or group is disabled, every member of the group is disabled, the output is at its route limit, or the input already plays there. The body carries a reason (INPUT_DISABLED, OUTPUT_DISABLED, GROUP_DISABLED, ALL_MEMBERS_DISABLED, ROUTE_LIMIT_REACHED, INPUT_ALREADY_ON_OUTPUT); outputId is present only for output-level reasons. Fix the state and retry

delete.summary: Stop every currently active route system-wide
delete.description: Stops all active routes regardless of target. Idempotent — if no routes are active, succeeds with stoppedCount 0. Best-effort: a route that fails to stop individually does not fail the whole request. This endpoint has no server-side confirmation gate; any client exposing it to an end user is responsible for confirming with that user first.

200.description: Stop-all completed (possibly with zero routes stopped)

post.summary: Transfer an active route to a new output or group
post.description: Moves playback to a new target without interrupting outputs that are in both. The route keeps its routeId. Atomic: if a new output fails to open, the route keeps playing where it was.

400.description: Validation error or route not transferable

409.description: Route not admitted: the input, output or group is disabled, every member of the group is disabled, the output is at its route limit, or the input already plays there, or the route is still adding an output that was just enabled. The body carries a reason (INPUT_DISABLED, OUTPUT_DISABLED, GROUP_DISABLED, ALL_MEMBERS_DISABLED, ROUTE_LIMIT_REACHED, INPUT_ALREADY_ON_OUTPUT, ROUTE_CHANGING_OUTPUTS); outputId is present only for output-level reasons. Fix the state and retry; ROUTE_CHANGING_OUTPUTS clears by itself within moments

post.description: Provides instant playback: supply a URI and target, and the system automatically creates an ephemeral input and route. Supports YouTube, SoundCloud, and other URI schemes. If volume is provided, it is set before playback starts.

409.description: Route not admitted: the input, output or group is disabled, every member of the group is disabled, the output is at its route limit, or the input already plays there. The body carries a reason (INPUT_DISABLED, OUTPUT_DISABLED, GROUP_DISABLED, ALL_MEMBERS_DISABLED, ROUTE_LIMIT_REACHED, INPUT_ALREADY_ON_OUTPUT); outputId is present only for output-level reasons. Fix the state and retry

get.description: Returns all inputs. By default only enabled inputs are returned; use includeDisabled=true to include disabled inputs.

parameters.name: includeDisabled
parameters.description: Include disabled inputs in the response

post.description: Registers an audio input that can be routed to outputs. It is ephemeral, lost at a restart, unless `persistent` is true: then the hub keeps it (origin STORED). Returns 201 with a Location header pointing to the created resource.

409.description: Input ID already exists (reason INPUT_ID_TAKEN), or the store keeps the most inputs it may (reason INPUT_STORE_FULL)

500.description: A kept (STORED) input could not be saved: the store is read-only, timed out or failed. The input is unchanged; `detail` names the cause

202.description: Request accepted; audio exists and is queued to play

400.description: Invalid request, unknown target, or unknown provider

503.description: Provider unavailable, errored, or returned an unconvertible format

post.summary: Synthesize and store a phrase without playing it
post.description: Stores the audio so a later announcement of the same text and voice is served from the cache with no provider call. Nothing is played, queued or pinned. A phrase already stored costs nothing and counts as just used. The extension does not rate limit warm-ups

200.description: The audio is stored (cacheHit false) or already was (true)

503.description: The provider failed, or the audio could not be stored (CACHE_WRITE_FAILED); nothing was stored and repeating the request is safe

get.summary: Get a single route by ID
get.description: Returns the route with its current status and timestamps.

delete.description: Stops audio playback and removes the route. Ephemeral inputs with autoRemove=true are cleaned up automatically.

get.description: Returns all outputs with current volume and mute state. By default only enabled outputs are returned.

parameters.name: includeDisabled
parameters.description: Include disabled outputs in the response

get.summary: Get a single output by ID
get.description: Returns the output with current volume and mute state.

get.summary: List the routes playing on a single output
get.description: Every route playing on the output — addressed to it directly or to a group it belongs to — in the order they joined it, each with its join mode, how it sounds on this output (duckState) and whether it is the output's main route.

delete.summary: Stop every route associated with a single output
delete.description: Stops routes addressed directly to this output, and any group route whose group currently includes this output as a member (the whole group route is stopped, since a single output cannot be detached from a live group route). Idempotent and best-effort, matching DELETE /api/v2/routes semantics.

200.description: Stop completed (possibly with zero routes stopped)

get.summary: Get a single input by ID
get.description: Returns the input if it exists.

delete.description: Removes a previously registered ephemeral input. Configuration inputs cannot be deleted.

400.description: Input is a configuration input and cannot be deleted

500.description: A kept (STORED) input could not be saved: the store is read-only, timed out or failed. The input is unchanged; `detail` names the cause

get.description: Takes no parameters and touches no device. `200` with `product` equal to `multiroom` identifies the hub. A changed `startedAt` means the hub restarted, which drops every playing route and the on/off overrides. A hub without this endpoint answers 404.
Returns all groups with their member output IDs. By default only enabled groups are returned.

parameters.name: includeDisabled
parameters.description: Include disabled groups in the response

get.summary: Get a single group by ID
get.description: Returns the group with its member output IDs.
Returns the inventory captured at start-up: every extension JAR found, including rejected ones, with its status and (for REJECTED) the reason.

The chimes loaded from `audio.chimes.sounds` at start-up, in configuration order. An entry that could not be loaded is not listed. `none` is a reserved word for "no chime" and never appears here. Always `200`; the list is empty when none is configured.

get.summary: List the voices a provider offers

200.description: Matching voices; google-cloud: sorted by language, engine, then short name; google-gemini: sorted by name

400.description: Unknown provider, a type that does not list voices, or a malformed filter

503.description: The voice catalogue cannot be fetched now

get.description: Largest first. The full list has more than ten thousand entries, so it is paged; filter it with `name`. Each page is remembered by the hub for 6 hours.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Part of the tag name, any letter case. Blank counts as not given. `%` and `/` are refused.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. A value outside the range is refused, never reduced.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the page starts. Send the previous answer's `nextOffset`.

400.description: A malformed or out-of-range value, an unknown or repeated parameter (invalid-parameter)

502.description: The catalogue answered with something unreadable (catalogue-bad-answer)

503.description: No catalogue server answered in time (catalogue-unavailable)

get.description: Returns stations matching every filter given, never ones the catalogue marks as broken. With no parameters: the 20 most-voted stations. The order among stations with equal values is not stable, so a client that pages drops stations whose `uuid` it has already received. A parameter this request does not define, or one sent twice, answers 400.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Part of the station name, any letter case. Blank counts as not given. `%` is refused.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: One whole tag, any letter case ("jazz" does not match "acid jazz"). Find tags through `/api/radio/tags`.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: One whole language name as `/api/radio/languages` gives it, any letter case.

parameters.name: codec
parameters.description: The catalogue's codec label, whole, any letter case (for example MP3, AAC+).

parameters.name: bitrateMin
parameters.description: Lowest bitrate in kbit/s. Stations of unknown bitrate are excluded when it is above 0.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Defaults to `desc` for `votes` and `clickCount`, `asc` for `name` and `bitrate`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. A value outside the range is refused, never reduced.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the page starts. Send the previous answer's `nextOffset`.

400.description: A malformed or out-of-range value, an unknown or repeated parameter (invalid-parameter); `parameter` names it. The catalogue was not contacted.

502.description: The catalogue answered with something unreadable or refused the request (catalogue-bad-answer)

503.description: No catalogue server answered within the time budget (catalogue-unavailable); `Retry-After` says when to try again

default.description: 405 for a method other than GET (method-not-allowed), 404 for an unknown path under /api/radio/ (not-found), 500 for an unexpected failure (internal-error)

get.description: Returned whether or not the catalogue marks it as broken (see `lastCheckOk`). May be up to 5 minutes old.

parameters.name: uuid
parameters.description: The station UUID, any letter case.

400.description: The UUID is malformed, or a query parameter was sent (invalid-parameter)

404.description: A well-formed UUID the catalogue does not know (station-not-found); the detail names it

502.description: The catalogue answered with something unreadable (catalogue-bad-answer)

503.description: No catalogue server answered in time (catalogue-unavailable)

get.description: The whole list, largest first. Remembered by the hub for 6 hours. Accepts no parameters.

502.description: The catalogue answered with something unreadable (catalogue-bad-answer)

503.description: No catalogue server answered in time (catalogue-unavailable)

get.description: The whole list, largest first. Remembered by the hub for 6 hours. Counts exclude broken stations and are close to, not equal to, what a search returns. Accepts no parameters.

502.description: The catalogue answered with something unreadable (catalogue-bad-answer)

503.description: No catalogue server answered in time (catalogue-unavailable)

delete.summary: Stop every route associated with a group
delete.description: Stops routes addressed directly to this group, and any route addressed directly to one of the group's member outputs. Idempotent and best-effort, matching DELETE /api/v2/routes semantics.

200.description: Stop completed (possibly with zero routes stopped)

VolumeRequest.description: Request body for setting volume level

startedAt.description: Timestamp when audio began playing (nullable before playback starts)

transferable.description: Whether route can be transferred to another target

pauseable.description: Whether the input driving this route supports pause/resume

joinMode.description: How the route joined its target (REPLACE, MIX or DUCK_OTHERS)

outputs.description: Outputs the route plays on right now, in join order. A group route lists only the members it plays on

routeVolume.description: The route's own volume (0-100), replacing its outputs' volume for this route only; null when the route follows each output's volume

duckingLevelDb.description: How far a DUCK_OTHERS route lowers the others, in dB; null for other join modes

type.description: Static URN identifying the error type

title.description: Short, stable title for the error type

detail.description: Human-readable explanation of this specific error

instance.description: Request URI that caused this error

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when error occurred

reason.description: Why a request was refused with 409; present on route admission and input errors. ROUTE_LIMIT_REACHED: a target output already holds the most routes it may. INPUT_ALREADY_ON_OUTPUT: the input already plays on a target output through another route. INPUT_DISABLED: the input is disabled. OUTPUT_DISABLED: the target output is disabled. GROUP_DISABLED: the target group is disabled. ALL_MEMBERS_DISABLED: every member of the target group is disabled. ROUTE_CHANGING_OUTPUTS: the route is still adding an output, so it cannot be transferred yet; transient, retry shortly. INPUT_UNPLAYABLE: the stored input's link has no handler or resolver, for example because its extension is not running; retry once it is back. INPUT_ID_TAKEN: another input, configured, kept, unplayable or unreadable in the store, already has the id. INPUT_STORE_FULL: the store already keeps the most inputs it may. More reasons may be added: treat an unknown one as a generic conflict.

outputId.description: The first output that failed the admission check; present only on route admission errors, and absent for INPUT_DISABLED, INPUT_UNPLAYABLE, GROUP_DISABLED and ROUTE_CHANGING_OUTPUTS

PauseRequest.description: Request body for setting pause state on a route

paused.description: true to pause playback, false to resume playback

OutputVolumeResponse.description: Confirmation of applied volume level for an output

outputId.description: The output ID that was modified

volume.description: The volume level that was applied (0-100)

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when volume was set

MuteRequest.description: Request body for setting mute state

muted.description: true to mute, false to unmute

OutputMuteResponse.description: Confirmation of applied output mute state

outputId.description: The output ID that was modified

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when mute state was set

EnabledRequest.description: Set the enabled state of an audio input

enabled.description: Whether the input should be enabled

OutputResponse.description: Audio output device details with current volume and mute state

enabled.description: Whether output is enabled for new route creation

chime.description: Chime played before a route that starts on this output after it has been silent for a while, as configured (an id or `none`); null when none is set. An id that is not loaded is reported but ignored

muted.description: true if master mute is active, false if unmuted

InputResponse.description: Audio input details with source and creation metadata

source.description: EPHEMERAL for any input added at runtime (create, play, DLNA); STATIC for configuration inputs

createdAt.description: Creation time of a runtime input, identical on every read; null for configuration inputs

defaultJoinMode.description: Join mode for routes from this input whose request names none; null when none is declared

defaultRouteVolume.description: Route volume (0-100) for routes from this input whose request names none; null when none is declared

defaultDuckingLevelDb.description: Ducking level in dB for DUCK_OTHERS routes from this input whose request names none; null when none is declared

defaultChime.description: Chime for routes from this input whose request names none, as configured (an id or `none`); null when none is declared

origin.description: Where the input lives: CONFIGURATION (multiroom.yml), STORED (kept by the hub across restarts) or RUNTIME (lost at restart)

playable.description: Whether a handler or resolver supports the input's link now. A kept input whose extension is not running reads false

unplayableReason.description: Why the input cannot play; null when it can
examples: no input handler or resolver supports scheme 'radiobrowser'

DisplayNameRequest.description: Rename an audio input, or restore its original name

displayName.description: New display name, at most 64 characters after trimming; null or blank restores the original name

GroupVolumeResponse.description: Confirmation of applied volume level for a group

groupId.description: The group ID that was modified

volume.description: The volume level that was applied (0-100)

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when volume was set

GroupMuteResponse.description: Confirmation of applied group mute state

groupId.description: The group ID that was modified

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when mute state was set

GroupResponse.description: Audio output group with member output IDs

muted.description: Whether all member outputs are muted

enabled.description: Whether group is enabled for new route creation

system.description: Whether the hub maintains this group itself (the broadcast group of every room) rather than the operator configuring it

chime.description: Chime played before a route addressed to this group, as configured (an id or `none`); null when none is set. Its members' own chimes are not used for a group route

CreateRouteRequest.description: Request body for creating an audio route

targetId.description: ID of the destination output or group

joinMode.description: How the route joins the target: REPLACE stops the routes playing there (except ducking routes), MIX plays alongside them, DUCK_OTHERS plays alongside and lowers them while it plays. Omitted: the input's default join mode, else REPLACE

routeVolume.description: Volume (0-100) of this route only. It replaces the target outputs' volume for this route and changes no output's volume, so the room's volume control does not reach it (for announcements and alerts). Mute, master mute and each output's configured gain still apply. Omitted: the input's default route volume, else the route follows the outputs' volume

duckingLevelDb.description: How far this route lowers the others, in dB from -60.0 to 0.0. Accepted only when the route's join mode is DUCK_OTHERS (400 otherwise). Omitted: the input's default ducking level, else the system level

chime.description: The chime that starts this route's audio: omitted = the input's default chime, then the target's; none = no chime, whatever those say; anything else = a chime id from GET /api/v2/chimes (400 if it is not loaded). A chime is a request: it is skipped when every target output is already playing

TransferRequest.description: Request body for transferring a route to a new target

targetId.description: ID of the destination output or group

PlaybackRequest.description: Request body for instant URI-based playback

targetId.description: ID of the destination output or group

displayName.description: Optional friendly name for the ephemeral input

volume.description: Deprecated alias of outputVolume. Not accepted together with it

joinMode.description: How the playback joins the target: REPLACE stops the routes playing there (except ducking routes), MIX plays alongside them, DUCK_OTHERS plays alongside and lowers them while it plays (an announcement). Omitted: REPLACE

outputVolume.description: Optional volume (0-100) set on the target output, or on every member of a target group, before playback starts. It persists after playback stops and is the room's volume: the volume control of that room changes it. Use routeVolume for this playback only

routeVolume.description: Optional volume (0-100) of this playback only. It replaces the target outputs' volume for this playback and changes no output's volume, so the room's volume control does not reach it (for announcements and alerts). Mute, master mute and each output's configured gain still apply. Omitted: the input's default, else the playback follows the outputs' volume

duckingLevelDb.description: How far this playback lowers the others, in dB from -60.0 to 0.0. Accepted only with joinMode DUCK_OTHERS. Omitted: the system ducking level

chime.description: The chime that starts this route's audio: omitted = the input's default chime, then the target's; none = no chime, whatever those say; anything else = a chime id from GET /api/v2/chimes (400 if it is not loaded). A chime is a request: it is skipped when every target output is already playing

PlaybackResponse.description: Playback result with ephemeral input and route details

message.description: Success message describing the playback state

displayName.description: The input's display name once the route exists: the name sent with the request, the title the link resolved to, or a generated placeholder

CreateInputRequest.description: Request body for creating a new ephemeral audio input

inputId.description: Unique identifier for the input (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores, 1-255 chars)

uri.description: Source URI (http://, file://, alsa://, signal://, etc.)

enabled.description: Whether input is active (defaults to true)

autoRemove.description: Auto-remove input when its route is stopped (defaults to false)

defaultJoinMode.description: Join mode for routes from this input whose request names none (REPLACE, MIX or DUCK_OTHERS); omitted: none declared, routes fall back to REPLACE

defaultRouteVolume.description: Route volume (0-100) for routes from this input whose request names none; it replaces the outputs' volume for that route only. Omitted: none declared, routes follow the outputs' volume

defaultDuckingLevelDb.description: Ducking level in dB (-60.0 to 0.0) for DUCK_OTHERS routes from this input whose request names none. Omitted: none declared, the system level applies

defaultChime.description: Chime for routes from this input whose request names none: a chime id from GET /api/v2/chimes, or `none` for no chime. Omitted: no opinion, the output's or group's chime applies. An id that is not loaded is refused with 400

persistent.description: Keep the input across hub restarts (defaults to false). A kept input has origin STORED, is never removed automatically, and cannot be combined with autoRemove (400). A link no handler or resolver supports is refused with 400

targetName.description: ID of the output or output group (not its display name): 1-255 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores. Any other name answers 400 TARGET_NOT_FOUND

routeVolume.description: Volume (0-100) of this announcement only. It replaces the target outputs' volume for the announcement and changes no output's volume, so the room's volume control does not reach it. Omitted: tts.playback.route-volume, else the announcement follows the outputs' volume

duckingLevelDb.description: How far this announcement lowers what else plays, in dB from -60.0 to 0.0. Accepted only with playbackMode duck-others (400 with mix). Omitted: tts.playback.ducking-level-db, else the hub's input default and system level

chime.description: Chime that starts this announcement: the id of a chime the hub has loaded (GET /api/v2/chimes), or none for no chime. An unknown id answers 400 INVALID_REQUEST. The hub skips it when every target output is already playing. Omitted: tts.playback.chime, else the target's own chime setting

cacheHit.description: true if the audio was already stored and no provider was called

RouteOnOutputResponse.description: A route playing on an output, with its duck state there and whether it is the output's main route

targetId.description: Target output or group ID; a group route appears under each member output

joinMode.description: How the route joined its target (REPLACE, MIX or DUCK_OTHERS)

startedAt.description: Timestamp when audio began playing (nullable before playback starts)

transferable.description: Whether route can be transferred to another target

pauseable.description: Whether the input driving this route supports pause/resume

duckState.description: How the route sounds on this output: FULL, or LOWERED under a ducking route. More values may be added; treat an unknown one as FULL

main.description: Whether this is the output's main route: the first non-ducking route to join it, else the first route

routeVolume.description: The route's own volume (0-100), replacing the output's volume for this route only; null when the route follows the output's volume

duckingLevelDb.description: How far a DUCK_OTHERS route lowers the others, in dB; null for other join modes

HubInfoResponse.description: Which hub is running, and since when

product.description: Always `multiroom`; tells the hub from another server on the same address

version.description: The hub's build version. `unknown` when the build carries no version, so a client must not assume a semantic version

apiVersion.description: The REST API version the hub provides. `unknown` when the build carries no version, so a client must not assume a semantic version

startedAt.description: When the hub process started. Equal on every call of one process, so a change means a restart. It can be wrong after a cold boot of the host (clock not yet synchronised): compare it, do not trust it

uptimeSeconds.description: Whole seconds since the process started

ChimeListResponse.description: The chimes the hub has loaded, in configuration order

chimes.description: Every loaded chime; empty when none is configured. The reserved word `none` (no chime) is never listed

ChimeResponse.description: A chime the hub has loaded

id.description: The id to send as `chime` or `defaultChime`

durationMillis.description: How long the chime plays, in milliseconds

name.description: The value to send as `tag` in a search

nextOffset.description: The offset of the next page; null on the last page

type.description: One of urn:multiroom:radio:error:invalid-parameter, :station-not-found, :catalogue-bad-answer, :catalogue-unavailable, :method-not-allowed, :not-found, :internal-error. More may be added.

title.description: A short fixed title for the type

parameter.description: The offending parameter; only on invalid-parameter

uuid.description: The station's stable identifier, lower case

favicon.description: An http or https address the hub has not fetched or checked

homepage.description: An http or https address the hub has not fetched or checked

languages.description: At most 10 language names, in the catalogue's order

tags.description: At most 30 tags, in the catalogue's order

codec.description: The catalogue's label, for example MP3, AAC+, OGG, UNKNOWN

hls.description: An HLS stream; the hub may be configured to refuse these when played

lastCheckOk.description: Whether the catalogue's last check of the stream succeeded
